title: Empowering Children to Create AI-Enabled Augmented Reality Experiences
abstract: arXiv:2508.08467v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Despite their potential to enhance children's learning experiences, AI-enabled AR technologies are predominantly used in ways that position children as consumers rather than creators. We introduce Capybara, an AR-based and AI-powered visual programming environment that empowers children to create, customize, and program 3D characters overlaid onto the physical world. Capybara enables children to create virtual characters and accessories using text-to-3D generative AI models, and to animate these characters through auto-rigging and body tracking. In addition, our system employs vision-based AI models to recognize physical objects, allowing children to program interactive behaviors between virtual characters and their physical surroundings. translated_title: 赋能儿童创造AI驱动的增强现实体验
translated_abstract: 尽管AI驱动的增强现实技术有潜力提升儿童的学习体验，但它们在当前主要被用于将儿童定位为消费者而非创造者。我们引入了Capybara，一个基于AR和AI驱动的可视化编程环境，使儿童能够创建、定制和编程覆盖在物理世界上的3D角色。Capybara利用文本到3D的生成式AI模型，让儿童能够创建虚拟角色和配件，并通过自动绑定和身体追踪来动画化这些角色。此外，我们的系统采用基于视觉的AI模型来识别物理对象，使儿童能够编程虚拟角色与其物理环境之间的交互行为。我们通过一系列新颖的AR体验展示了Capybara的表现力。我们与来自美国和阿根廷的20名儿童进行了用户研究。我们的研究结果表明，Ca（摘要截断）
tldr: Capybara是一个AR和AI驱动的可视化编程环境，使儿童能够通过生成式AI和视觉识别技术创造并编程3D角色与物理世界交互，从而从消费者转变为创造者。
en_tdlr: Capybara is an AR and AI-powered visual programming environment that empowers children to create and program 3D characters interacting with the physical world via generative AI and vision recognition, transforming them from consumers into creators.
